title: A/P Detail: the CSV has one row per document and no group rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a new vendor (created for this test), vendor A, with two overdue bills on today's date: bill A, dated a day you note as date A, amount $1,250.50, 31 to 60 days past due, and bill B, amount $75.00, 1 to 30 days past due.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Vendor filter showing vendor A ticked.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  2. Open the CSV in a plain text editor.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 2:

  • The file starts with the "As of: ", "Locations: All locations" and "Vendor: " rows, one line each.
  • The heading row follows directly, written letter for letter as the screen's headings, with an "Aging Bucket" column and a "Vendor Name" column.
  • One row for bill A.
  • Its Aging Bucket reads "31-60 days past due" (the bucket's name as the screen shows it) and its Vendor Name reads vendor A's name, each in its own column.
  • Its Date reads date A written year-month-day (for example 2026-09-01).
  • Its Amount reads 1250.50 (no $ sign, no thousands comma, two decimals).
  • One row for bill B, whose Aging Bucket reads "1-30 days past due".
  • No group header or subtotal row.
  • One Totals row at the bottom, whose Amount is 1325.50 (1250.50 + 75.00).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • S3-R8: “The CSV starts with the lines of S3-R5, each in its own row, in this order: As of, Locations, then Past due and the customer or vendor line only when set. The column heading row follows directly, then one flat table: one row per customer or vendor (Summaries) or per document (Detail, Collection, Unpaid Invoices), with the aging bucket, customer or vendor in its own column; no group header or subtotal rows; one Totals row at the bottom. Money is a plain number with two decimals, and an empty bucket is a blank cell; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.”
  • S3-R8b: “The CSV column headings are the on-screen headings, letter for letter (S2-R4a): "Customer Full Name" on A/R Detail, "Customer" on A/R Collection, "Vendor Name" on the A/P reports. The bucket column on A/R Detail and A/P Detail is headed "Aging Bucket", and its values are the bucket names shown on screen.”
  • S2-R4a: “Column headings are in Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as on the other reports (Sales By Customer, Inventory Value, Parts Velocity): the A/R reports read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due" and "Open Balance", the same as the A/P reports.”
